steps.claim: Pair the two lightest remaining items whenever they fit.
steps.justification: This uses capacity efficiently for small items.

steps.claim: Pairing lightest first is always optimal.
The algorithm is O(n log n).

algorithm: Sort weights and repeatedly group the two lightest if possible, otherwise group the lightest alone.
correctness_argument: This greedy fails because it can consume two light items that should each pair with heavier items.
final_output_or_verdict: Fails on cases like 20 40 50 50 with limit 90.
